Moldova
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Budapest, Hungary, or bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Bucharest, Romania.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Republic of Moldova are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of 180 days, starting from the day of entry.
